subject: Acme Devices - onboarding docs: coverage scope, effective dates, and PO timing
messages:
From: Tim Reynolds <tim.reynolds@acme-devices.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme-devices.com, lena.ortiz@acme-devices.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME onboarding packet and COI (first pass)

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the welcome — attached are the docs you requested to get Acme Devices set up: COI, a current subcontractor list, and our completed vendor risk questionnaire. A few notes up front: 

- COI shows general liability and umbrella limits that meet the numbers on your checklist. The cyber liability policy is separate and listed on page 3.
- Subcontractor list includes two smaller partners we use for field installs; we can get endorsements for them if needed.
- VRQ has a couple of redaction markers where we removed customer names per NDAs.

We'd like to avoid delaying the PO if possible — can you confirm whether the COI needs the Additional Insured endorsement to be uploaded, or whether a conditional PO can be issued while we secure endorsements? Tim or Lena can get endorsements within 5 business days if Redwood requires them.

Attachments: ACME_COI_2027-04-08.pdf (pdf), ACME_Subcontractor_List.xlsx (xlsx), ACME_VRQ_completed.docx (docx)

Best,
Tim Reynolds
Head of Ops, Acme Devices
Tim.Reynolds@acme-devices.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Reynolds <tim.reynolds@acme-devices.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME onboarding packet and COI (first pass)

Hi Tim — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending everything up front. Couple of clarifying asks from procurement and security so we can move to PO: 

1) Additional Insured / Waiver of Subrogation: Procurement requires an Additional Insured endorsement on the General Liability COI for schedule-of-work contracts. If you can provide that endorsement PDF we can proceed to a conditional PO. If not, procurement has asked for a timeline to get it.

2) Effective dates: the COI shows an expiration of 2028-03-31; procurement will accept that but wants confirmation the aggregate limits are not shared with other named accounts (a short attestation is OK).

3) Cyber liability: security requests the cyber policy declarations page showing the limits and retroactive date. If the insurer will not share details, a broker letter is acceptable.

4) Subcontractors: can you mark which subs perform on-site work vs purely remote services? That affects whether we need endorsements for subs.

If you can get the Additional Insured endorsement and the cyber declarations page within 5 business days, procurement is comfortable issuing a conditional PO with net-30 payment terms and activation once we receive the endorsement. If the endorsement will take longer, we'll need to keep the request in "pending documentation" and hold off booking to the PO system (which may push the go-live by a couple of weeks).

Thanks — looping Sean for procurement scheduling and Karthik for risk intake.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
From: Tim Reynolds <tim.reynolds@acme-devices.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-devices.com>, procurement@acme-devices.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME onboarding packet and COI (first pass)

Grace — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick updates: 

- Additional Insured: our broker confirmed they can issue the endorsement; estimated delivery April 16 (attached is the broker acknowledgement).
- Aggregates: insurer confirms per-policy aggregate not shared across named accounts for our GL policy; broker provided a short letter (attached).
- Cyber declarations: attached is the declarations page redacted per insurer guidance; it shows a $5M aggregate and retroactive date of 2023-06-01.
- Subcontractors: in the subcontractor list we marked two vendors as "on-site installs" (lines 2 and 3) — they are local contractors and we will get endorsements for them if Redwood requires.

We can accept a conditional PO in writing as long as the PO language notes "activation contingent on delivery of Additional Insured endorsement within 5 business days of PO issuance." Would Redwood be able to issue the conditional PO today? That would help us reserve staffing for the week of April 19.

Attachments: broker_acknowledgement.pdf, cyber_declarations_redacted.pdf

Best,
Tim
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Tim Reynolds <tim.reynolds@acme-devices.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME onboarding packet and COI (first pass)

Tim — appreciate the fast follow and the broker notes. Grace and I reviewed procurement routing: we will issue a conditional PO today with the activation clause you suggested. Two operational notes: 

- PO will be net-30 from activation date (not issuance); please confirm billing remit and W-9 routing so finance can finish the vendor profile.
- If the Additional Insured endorsement arrives later than April 21, please confirm whether Acme can absorb any rescheduling costs for on-site crews; we don't want to double-book internal teams.

Grace — can you start the PO in Coupa and tag this as expedited? Karthik — please open the risk intake ticket with the cyber declarations attached; we'll close once Karthik confirms limits.

Tim — approving conditional PO now; expect a follow-up doc with PO number and activation clause.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
